recognitionRules: Use a restrained sans-serif masthead and broad white margins around work.
Keep image captions immediately attached to the corresponding object.
Make chronology a vertical sequence of date and event pairs.
Reserve rust for links; gray rules organize the catalogue without competing with images.

writingLinks.name: Reflective critic
writingLinks.reason: A quiet presentation that pairs close viewing with captions and honest source records.

quote: Look closely. Read the note. Return to the work.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use OBJECTS IN SEQUENCE as a small Arimo wordmark aligned to the image edge. No symbol: the consistent caption alignment is the identifying gesture.
invariants: Use a restrained sans-serif masthead and broad white margins around work.
Keep image captions immediately attached to the corresponding object.
Make chronology a vertical sequence of date and event pairs.
adaptations: A printed list can replace large images with numbered thumbnails.
Keep the same caption order when works change.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
